skill.summary: Provides detailed history, design, and business insights on Lamborghini, covering its origins, model lineup, VW Group strategy, and brand identity.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Automobili Lamborghini skill.
- Includes a detailed historical timeline, from Ferruccio Lamborghini’s origins to integration into VW Group and electrification.
- Outlines brand-defining design, business model under Volkswagen, and unique value differentiation.
- Summarizes key financial and operational data up to 2024.
- Highlights notable stories and trivia about Lamborghini’s heritage and product naming.
